evidence.title: Construction of the LUMI-AI data center in full swing
evidence.publisher: CSC – IT Center for Science Ltd.
evidence.attribution: CSC – IT Center for Science Ltd.
evidence.excerpt: CSC says a new LUMI-AI data center is being built inside the former paper-machine hall at Renforsin Ranta, with actual construction begun in January 2026 and construction well underway in March.

metadata.status_scope: CSC reports a new data center being built, actual construction begun in January 2026, concrete castings and structural work completed, and construction well underway as of the dated article. This supports one generic under_construction observation and does not create separate foundation, shell, MEP, commissioning, completion, or operating lifecycle rows.
metadata.forecast_guardrail: Spring 2027 production readiness is a future, season-level forecast, not an exact target date or evidence of commissioning, completion, production, or operation.
metadata.alias_scope_guardrail: Both reported aliases refer to the same new data-center development and apply to the single campus/project lineage in this record. They do not create separate assets.
metadata.planned_hosting_guardrail: The data center is being built to host these future systems, procurement is still ongoing, and the systems are expected only after facility completion. The schema cannot stage workload observations as planned, so no current workload, installed hardware, model, production, tenant, customer, or user observation is created.
metadata.role_scope: CSC expressly identifies SRV as the main contractor, so that current project role is normalized. CSC's team is described as responsible for operating the data center only once completed; no current operator role is created because the schema cannot stage roles as future.
metadata.same_hall_context_as_reported: The prior LUMI data center built in 2022 and the Roihu supercomputer added in 2025 share the same former paper-machine hall.
metadata.collision_guardrail: Physical co-location in the same hall is retained as collision context only. The new LUMI-AI data center is not merged with the 2022 LUMI data center, Roihu, another CSC entity, or a hall-level unique site; no complete inventory or unique-site claim is made.
metadata.heat_recovery_plan_as_reported: CSC plans to capture excess heat from the future new supercomputer for the local district-heating network.
